active_assets.prompt:
Use case: illustration-story. Asset: outdoor background panorama for a side-view hamster platform game. Attached hamster is the style reference.
White paper, BLACK INK only. Sparse raw pen sketch with bold imperfect outer strokes and a few finer botanical lines. A LITTLE believable anatomy in tree trunks and branches, but very minimalist. No gray fills or shading.
A quiet open meadow at the edge of a woodland: two loosely drawn slender deciduous trees off-center, natural branching trunks and a few leaf clusters, low distant rolling hills, one sparse clump of tall grass near an edge. The whole upper half is wide empty white SKY. Lots of open breathing room in the middle for the hamster. No roof, masonry, arches, cave, dungeon, buildings or enclosed spaces.
Wide 3:1 panorama, flat side elevation. Distant trees stand on the same soft distant horizon around the lower quarter; the very bottom stays empty white. Keep foreground gameplay separate: NO foreground floor, platforms, floating logs, fences or gates. Tree masses must be airy line drawings, not dense black or gray filled canopies. Selected thick black trunk edges, a few branch forks, economical natural shapes; no repeated cartoon bubble canopy, no realistic rendering, gradients, shadows, detailed bark texture, full foliage, dense hatching or decoration.
No characters, text, labels, borders or UI. The feeling is an outdoor white-paper indie comic, understated and a little rough, with believable natural forms.

palette: White object fills and sky; black ink lines. No gray washes, colored surfaces, gradients, or dark atmosphere.
setting: One continuous outdoor route in three 4000-pixel sections: The Meadow Path, Willow Creek and The Remembering Grove. Each has four creek gaps and a longer sequence of grassy rises. Flags are checkpoints. Old sections retire only after leaving the view, and lock out backtracking.

font.delivery: Locally embedded Roman and Italic faces in src/theme-type.css

unused_asset_specs.prompt:
Use case: illustration-story. Asset: transparent outdoor terrain sheet for a white-paper 2D hamster platform game, TWO equal horizontal rows on 1536x1024.
Style reference: attached hamster. WHITE solid object interiors, BLACK sketch ink contours. Slightly believable natural forms but very economical: heavy uneven outer strokes, few finer inner lines, sparse raw pen drawing. No color, gray shading, gradients, shadows or background.
TOP ROW y0-511: ONE continuous side-on EARTH BANK strip spanning the full image width. A flat walkable top edge at y125, with nothing projecting above it. Beneath: an irregular white soil cut face descending to y500, a few embedded stones of unequal sizes and two small exposed roots; no masonry courses or repeated brick pattern. Thick black uneven top edge, a few short thin soil lines only. Left/right same height to tile; open white soil face, no solid black underground fill. Transparent ABOVE the bank, bank itself solid white.
BOTTOM ROW y512-1023: ONE horizontal fallen TREE LOG from x70..1466, flat usable top y640, bottom y820. Slightly irregular outline, blunt cut end on the left with two loose growth rings, one small knot, just two short lengthwise wood grain lines. No leaves, grass, supports, branches or dangling objects; the game draws the supporting stumps separately so they root in the real terrain. Transparent around the log. Simple hand-drawn wooden beam, not stone.
Keep every piece fully within its row, no overlap across y512. No text, labels, grid, backdrop, other objects or UI. The whole sheet should feel like spare black-pen natural scenery drawn for the exact hamster reference.

terrain.style: Continuous raised grass banks, white fills, black outlines, sparse grass and tiny dirt marks; no exposed roots or supports. World-anchored sample vertices prevent slope twitching when the camera moves. The short downhill grade is 90 pixels long, replacing the abrupt 20-pixel descent. Gentle grades stay walkable; genuinely steep descents use gravity. Feet cannot pass through solid soil; real gaps remain open.
terrain.sections: Every section has three Echo puzzles. Level one never attacks. Level two attacks require reachable cover. Level three's first and last puzzles can attack: the first uses a checked jump escape across its 150-pixel collapsing retreat hole onto solid landing ground, while the last uses raised-bank cover. Middle flat switches remain harmless. Grounded direction changes brake immediately for a quick retreat.

log_piles.behavior: Large tightly packed 24-log stacks, taller than a normal jump. Plate press flings randomized spinning debris with gravity, ground bounces and flat settling. Logs remain while held. On release, debris fades out sequentially as new pieces pop into place locally, bottom to top, in 0.72 seconds. Ground contacts only; sleeping debris and cached drawings reduce frame cost.
log_piles.damage: Ordinary scatter is harmless. Level one never attacks. Standard later traps require real reachable cover; level three's opening trap instead requires a checked jump escape and solid landing beyond its collapsing hole. Eligibility is checked before scheduling and launching. Eligible presses independently roll 50% / 70% chances from the first encounter; no guaranteed ambush and no held-frame rerolls. Flat middle switches stay harmless. All 24 hostile logs lift over 0.22 seconds and launch at 0.46 seconds independently of player movement, around 1600 to 1800 pixels per second. Joining an Echo-held or resolved plate never rearms it. Swept capsule collision checks terrain before damage.

sky_message.placement: World-anchored above the first death location; bold IM Fell English, no overlay. Once it leaves either camera edge, it disappears immediately and is permanently dismissed in saved memory. Later deaths never create another message. Restart all levels begins a fresh run.

echo.behavior: Two Echoes replay independently. Each replays only the latest second at normal movement speed. On an occupied switch, the clip begins during the most recent uninterrupted plate contact, so the clone holds immediately without replaying the approach. E is black when a slot is free and white when both are occupied; two small ink slots above it show capacity. Q vanishes both clones and starts a fresh clip while retaining the recent clip for immediate reuse, so E has no delay after Vanish; fallback clips use the same short replay. Fresh footsteps replace that fallback when enough have been recorded. Death and section changes clear both recordings. Each clone has its own circle timer. No dotted playback paths or numeric timers.

sprite_rendering: Main-pose alpha bounds exclude detached pixels from the preceding row in run frames four/five and jump frame five. Original sheet and equal frame assets remain unchanged.
ambient_animation: Always enabled automatically. Six idle poses, gently swaying grass and distant trees, moving creek ripples, bobbing seeds and fluttering checkpoint flags. Menu contains Resume, Restart, Sound and trail selection.
death_animation: Backward ballistic knockback with a tumbling body, flicker after 0.38 seconds, disappearance at 0.9 seconds. Camera eases from its current view back to the section spawn after disappearance. Respawn does not reset the camera, and begins with no Echo or old clip.
